    Title: Rain sensor shall correctly set LIN signal to 0x02 after a sudden power cycle
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Fault Injection
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Ensure the rain sensor is in an inactive state.
        2. Simulate a sudden power cycle (e.g., disconnect and <SIG> the power supply) to the ECU.
        3. Verify that within 100 ms after the power cycle, the LIN signal '<SIG_60>' is set to the initialization value of 0x02 (Lower Parking Position).

    Issue_Source: NHTSA#11449702

    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0159.ND-ChB.NEW.2

    Method:

      Technique: Fault Injection
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.1027.ND-ChB.NEW.1
    Title: Verification of PWM luminance scaling factor step size and intermediate values
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Equivalence Class Partitioning
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 0.500 and measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        2. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle is 50% ± 0.1%.
        3. Set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 0.250 and measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        4. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle is 25% ± 0.1%.
        5. Set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 0.750 and measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        6. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle is 75% ± 0.1%.
      Fail: |
        - Measured duty cycle at scaling factor 0.500 is not within [49.9%, 50.1%].
        - Measured duty cycle at scaling factor 0.250 is not within [24.9%, 25.1%].
        - Measured duty cycle at scaling factor 0.750 is not within [74.9%, 75.1%].
    Issue_Source: N/A

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.1027.ND-ChB.NEW.2
    Title: Verification of PWM luminance scaling factor behavior under fault conditions
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Fault Injection
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Inject a fault in the ECU (e.g., simulate a communication error or power glitch) while the PWM luminance scaling factor is set to 0.500.
        2. After the fault, verify that the PWM luminance scaling factor returns to its last known valid value (0.500) or a safe default value (e.g., 0.000).
        3. Measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        4. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle matches the <SIG> value based on the recovered scaling factor (e.g., 50% ± 0.1% if it returned to 0.500, or 0% ± 0.1% if it defaulted to 0.000).
      Fail: |
        - The PWM luminance scaling factor does not return to its last known valid value or a safe default value after the fault.
        - The measured PWM duty cycle does not match the <SIG> value based on the recovered scaling factor.
    Issue_Source: NHTSA#11653764

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0830.ND-ChB.NEW.1
    Title: Verification of FES push button actuation noise level under varying environmental conditions
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Environmental Stress Testing
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Mount the FES push button in its nominal installation configuration.
        2. Position a calibrated microphone at a distance of 60 cm ± 1 cm from the push button actuation point, in an anechoic or semi-anechoic chamber per ISO 3744.
        3. Actuate the push button with a standard force profile (e.g., 3 N ± 0.5 N) at a speed of 50 mm/s.
        4. Measure the loudness in Sone using a standardized psychoacoustic model (e.g., DIN 45631/A1).
        5. Repeat steps 3 and 4 under the following environmental conditions:
           - Temperature: -20°C, +20°C, +80°C
           - Humidity: 20%, 50%, 90%
           - Vibration: 0.5 g, 1 g, 2 g
        6. The measured loudness must be < 5.0 Sone for all tested environmental conditions.
      Fail: |
        - Measured loudness ≥ 5.0 Sone during any of the tested environmental conditions.
    Issue_Source: NHTSA#11656646

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0001_D.ND-ChB.NEW.1
    Title: Verify current sampling mechanism under transient conditions
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Fault Injection
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Apply a series of rapid, alternating current signals within the range of -300A to +300A (e.g., -250A, +250A, -200A, +200A) at a frequency of 10 Hz.
        2. Confirm that the system successfully samples and reports each value without error or saturation.
        3. Verify that the reported values are within the specified accuracy of ±3.5A.
      Fail: |
        - The system fails to sample or report any of the transient test points.
        - The system reports an out-of-range error for any input within [-300.0A, +300.0A].
        - The reported values exceed the specified accuracy of ±3.5A.
    Issue_Source: NHTSA#11448230

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0001_D.ND-ChB.NEW.2
    Title: Verify current sampling mechanism under extreme temperature conditions
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Environmental Stress Testing
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Place the ECU in a temperature-controlled chamber and set the temperature to -40°C and +85°C.
        2. Apply a steady current signal of 0.0A, -300A, and +300A at each temperature.
        3. Confirm that the system successfully samples and reports each value without error or saturation.
        4. Verify that the reported values are within the specified accuracy of ±3.5A.
      Fail: |
        - The system fails to sample or report any of the test points at either temperature.
        - The system reports an out-of-range error for any input within [-300.0A, +300.0A] at either temperature.
        - The reported values exceed the specified accuracy of ±3.5A at either temperature.
    Issue_Source: NHTSA#11608392
